title: Scene end-state columns are read but never written
summary: scenes.end_state_summary (migration 003) and scenes.end_frame_thumbnail_url (migration 013) are selected and read by the scene list, shot extraction, context manager and Stage 10 prior-scene thumbnail, but no statement in backend/src, src, backend/scripts or backend/quickies-sql writes either column. With the column null, shot extraction for every scene N>=2 receives the text 'No previous scene (this is the first scene).' in place of the prior end state.
notes: Repo-wide grep for end_state_summary returns only the migration, projects.ts and contextManager.ts reads. Values could only exist if written outside this repo (UNKNOWN for live databases). Consequence for CONT-069/070/071/072/073/074/076 and the Rearview ideas.

title: ContextManager local-context and prompt-assembly methods have no production callers
summary: Only assembleGlobalContext (routes/llm.ts and streamlineBackfillService) and formatForInjection (streamlineBackfillService, style-capsule backfill only) run outside tests. assembleLocalContext, assembleFullContext, prepareStageContext and formatPromptGenerationContext, including the asset-description priority truncation (props dropped first) at contextManager.ts:355-370, have no non-test caller.
notes: Adds assembleLocalContext and formatPromptGenerationContext to the DEAD-0010 list. Test coverage exists only for the dead methods, so tests pass without any live path.

title: LLM template route injects writing style and beat sheet only, not Ask Auteur facts
summary: POST /api/llm/generate-from-template (llm.ts:139) calls assembleGlobalContext but copies only the writing-style capsule and the beat sheet (stage 4 and later) into template variables. formatForInjection, which renders the ESTABLISHED FACTS block, is called only by the style-capsule backfill, and only when a writing capsule is present.
notes: Tests assert the ESTABLISHED FACTS block is produced by formatForInjection and by the private stage formatters (dead). They do not assert that a live route sends it.

title: Master-script re-approval hard-deletes removed scenes; UI copy says they become continuity_broken
summary: When the scene list is saved, matched scenes keep their id (match by slug, then by scene_number). Unmatched existing scenes are hard-deleted with scenes.delete().in(id). Stage 4 UI copy states deleted scenes will be marked continuity_broken, and continuityRiskAnalyzer reads that status, but no code writes status continuity_broken.
notes: Stable identity is preserved only for matched scenes. Writers of continuity_broken: none found in backend/src, src or backend/scripts.

title: Add-frame-as-reference stores a URL snapshot in the shot reference order as well as a frame_links row
summary: POST add-frame-as-reference writes a continuity-typed entry into shots.reference_image_order (or end_frame_reference_image_order) whose url is the source frame's image_url at link time, while also writing a frame_links reference row keyed by source frame id. Generation reads the persisted order list. propagateFrameLinks only handles match links, so a regenerated source frame does not update the copied URL in the order list.
notes: Two representations of one continuity reference: a live id link (frame_links) and a URL snapshot (reference order). Which one a given generation uses depends on the path (camera_change reads frame_links first; the generic path reads the order list). Runtime effect UNKNOWN without execution.

title: Stage 2 retroactive-revise button can never render
summary: Stage2Treatment declares isOutdated as local state initialised to false. The only setter call in the file sets it to false inside handleRetroactiveRevise. The button is rendered only when isOutdated is true, so it is unreachable. The handler itself only shows a toast and clears the flag; it performs no revision.
notes: Line 443 passes stageStatus === 'outdated' to a different child prop; it does not feed the local isOutdated state at line 467.

title: Shot extraction receives a master-script summary covering every scene
summary: The shot-extraction route builds masterScriptSummary from the locked Stage 4 formatted script: every INT/EXT heading plus the first action line of every scene, truncated to 100 characters. It passes this summary together with the active scene's own script excerpt. Non-active scenes are therefore present in summarised form in the Phase B extraction call.
notes: contextManager.ts repeats the same summary logic in its own fetchMasterScriptSummary, which is used only by the dead assembleGlobalContext branch that feeds llm.ts (live). Full-script summary is not written to any table.

title: Continuity risk is a status and timestamp rule, not a content comparison
summary: ContinuityRiskAnalyzer returns safe when there is no prior scene; risky when the prior scene status is not video_complete; broken when the scene status is outdated or continuity_broken, or when any stage 1-4 state row was created after the scene was last updated. It never reads end-state text. It is computed on the scene list and shown as an advisory badge and warning in Stage 6.
notes: Advisory only: no code path blocks or edits on the result.

title: frame_links allows one link per target frame and cascades on source deletion
summary: frame_links has UNIQUE(target_frame_id) after migration 035, so each target frame has at most one incoming link of either type. Both source_frame_id and target_frame_id reference frames with ON DELETE CASCADE. Deleting a source frame therefore silently removes every link that points from it, with no user-facing break event.
notes: Answers the open question about reference-link breakage in code: silent cascade removal. Note the match-link upsert at frames.ts:1949 uses onConflict target_frame_id, which replaces any reference link on that target.

title: shots.continuity_flags is free text whose only consumer is a cut-word regex
summary: Shot extraction asks the model for an optional array of strings named continuity_flags and stores it on shots. The only logic that reads it is determineContinuityLink, which forces the continuity mode to none when a flag matches cut, jump, transition, time-skip, new-scene or later. No structured handoff, entry, exit or prop-exchange flag exists.
notes: Shot-level continuity_flags is not the same field as transformation_flags. The regex is case-insensitive and matches substrings, so a flag such as 'later' also matches phrases unrelated to scene breaks.
